purpose: Whole-tree clean replay of the Lean project of release v1.13.0 (adds Paper 6 version 2).
procedure: Fresh directory; only sources and configuration copied from the release tree lean/ (Research.lean, Research/**/*.lean, Comparator/*.lean, lakefile.toml, lake-manifest.json, lean-toolchain); .lake/packages is a symlink to the shared Lake package cache of Mathlib and its dependencies at the pinned revisions (every package HEAD equal to lake-manifest.json, no tracked changes); fresh .lake/build (absent before the first build). No download.

Environment for every Lake and Lean run: PATH starts with the toolchain bin; LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2 (the rule to reduce it to 1 for later Lake commands after a sampled job RSS above 32 GB was not triggered); LAKE_NO_CACHE=true, LAKE_ARTIFACT_CACHE=false, LAKE_RESTORE_ARTIFACTS=false.

One job holding both Lean lock slots from setup to the end of the comparator rehearsal, in its own process group, under `caffeinate -i -s`, with the resource stops of the user's directive of 6 October 2026 (memory pressure critical for 60 s, more than 40 GB resident in the job, less than 20 GB free disk; no stop was reached; see job_guard).

R1: bounded topological build helper; per-command timeout and all resource rules unchanged. Read-only deps guard (`lake --no-build build +Research.AxialMSZ.Challenge:deps +Research.CirculantQ3:deps`); `lake build Research.CirculantQ3` alone; dependency-topological batches of at most 8 targets per `lake build` (default closure rooted at Research, which imports the Check modules of Papers 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10); `lake build` of the twelve audit modules; `lake build` of the seven ChallengeTests modules (Papers 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 10); `lake build` of the modules not reached from Research.lean (listed in build_other).

R2: the twelve audit files run with `lake env lean --threads=2` (plain text and --json); `lake env leanchecker <Module>` for every module except CirculantQ3 and the root module, two at a time (the rule to drain to one after a sampled job RSS above 32 GB was not triggered); forbidden-token scan of every .lean file under Research/ and Research.lean; `shasum -a 256 -c` of the replay manifest against the release tree lean/.

Axiom audit: every `#print axioms` output of the build logs (CirculantQ3, default target, ChallengeTests, other modules) and of the JSON output of the audit files, position-matched to the `#print axioms` commands in the .lean files.

resources_note: 'resources' summarizes resources.log, written by the first guard process up to 00:14:51 UTC; see job_guard for the rest of the run.

job_guard.note: The job ran in its own process group under the resource guard of the user's directive of 6 October 2026 (stop on memory pressure critical for 60 s, more than 40 GB resident in the job, less than 20 GB free disk, or 1800 s for one command). The first guard process stopped, for an unknown reason, after its sample of 00:14:51 UTC; the job went on. From 00:56:11 UTC a new guard process of Codex supervised the same process group, without changing its inputs, until 03:56:56 UTC, when it stopped the comparator run of Paper 6 that had reached the limit of 1800 s (after the end of the replay at 03:26:56 UTC). There is no resource record between 00:14:51 and 00:56:11 UTC. No other stop was reached.

first_attempt: A first attempt (8 October 2026, from 22:57 UTC) built the default target with one `lake build`, which was stopped by the limit of 1800 s per command; its logs are not published. This run built the same sources in batches.
